title: Cineole regulates Wnt/beta-catenin pathway through Nrf2/keap1/ROS to inhibit bisphenol A-induced apoptosis, autophagy inhibition and immunosuppression of grass carp hepatocytes.
authors: Chen, Lu; Tao, Dayong; Yu, Fuchang; Wang, Tian; Qi, Meng; Xu, Shiwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Cineole通过Nrf2/keap1/ROS调控Wnt通路抑制BPA诱导的草鱼肝细胞凋亡，核心是细胞信号通路与氧化应激，仅分子对接涉及keap1配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA), an environmental pollutant, can cause multiple organ tissue damage by inducing oxidative stress. Cineole (CIN) is a terpene oxide existing in a variety of plant essential oils, which has anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antioxidant effects. This study examined the effects of 200 nM BPA and 20 muM CIN on apoptosis, autophagy, and immunology in grass carp hepatocytes (L8824). The treatments were categorized as NC, CIN, BPA + CIN, and BPA. The findings demonstrated that BPA exposure could increase ROS levels and oxidative stress-related indicators, decrease the expression of the Nrf2/keap1 pathway and the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, increase the expression of genes involved in the apoptotic pathway (Bax and Caspase3), and decrease the expression of the anti-apoptotic gene Bcl-2 by lowering mitochondrial membrane potential. BPA also reduced the expression of genes linked to autophagy (ATG5, Beclin1, LC3). Changes in immunological function after BPA exposure were also shown by changes in the amounts of antimicrobial peptides (HEPC, beta-defensin, LEAP2) and cytokines (INF-gamma, IL-1beta, IL-2, and TNF-alpha). After the co-treatment of CIN and BPA, CIN can inhibit BPA-induced apoptosis and recover from autophagy and immune function to a certain extent by binding to keap1 to exert an anti-oxidative regulatory effect of Nrf2 incorporation into the nucleus. Molecular docking provides strong evidence for the interaction of CIN ligands with keap1 receptors. Therefore, these results indicated that CIN could inhibit BPA-induced apoptosis, autophagy inhibition and immunosuppression in grass carp hepatocytes by regulating the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway with Nrf2/keap1/ROS. This study provided further information to the risk assessment of the neuroendocrine disruptor BPA on aquatic organisms and offered suggestions and resources for further research into the function of natural extracts in the body's detoxification process.
abstract_zh: 双酚A（BPA）作为一种环境污染物，可通过诱导氧化应激造成多器官组织损伤。桉叶油素（CIN）是一种存在于多种植物精油中的萜烯氧化物，具有抗炎、镇痛和抗氧化作用。本研究探讨了200 nM BPA和20 μM CIN对草鱼肝细胞（L8824）凋亡、自噬及免疫学功能的影响。处理组分为NC、CIN、BPA+CIN和BPA四组。结果表明，BPA暴露可增加ROS水平及氧化应激相关指标，降低Nrf2/keap1通路和Wnt/β-catenin通路的表达，增加凋亡通路相关基因（Bax和Caspase3）的表达，并通过降低线粒体膜电位减少抗凋亡基因Bcl-2的表达。BPA还降低了自噬相关基因（ATG5、Beclin1、LC3）的表达。BPA暴露后免疫功能的变化亦通过抗菌肽（HEPC、β-防御素、LEAP2）和细胞因子（INF-γ、IL-1β、IL-2和TNF-α）水平的改变得以体现。在CIN与BPA联合处理后，CIN可通过与keap1结合，发挥Nrf2入核的抗氧调控作用，从而抑制BPA诱导的凋亡，并在一定程度上恢复自噬和免疫功能。分子对接为CIN配体与keap1受体的相互作用提供了有力证据。因此，这些结果表明，CIN可通过调控Wnt/β-catenin通路及Nrf2/keap1/ROS，抑制BPA诱导的草鱼肝细胞凋亡、自噬抑制及免疫抑制。本研究为神经内分泌干扰物BPA对水生生物的风险评估提供了进一步信息，并为天然提取物在机体解毒过程中的功能研究提供了建议和资源。
